# DG Property

> De Gennaro Property is a South African commercial property brokerage specialising in commercial leasing, investment sales, retail leasing, development land and fuel-station opportunities.

Canonical website: https://dg-property.co.za
Primary location: Bedfordview, Johannesburg, Gauteng, South Africa
Contact: hello@dg-property.co.za | 087 630 2532
